item.title: First bill of 2026 legislative session aiming to mitigate electric bill spikes clears General Assembly
item.description: Senate Bill 172, which aims to address "sudden spikes in electric bills caused by sharp increases in fuel costs, particularly during extreme weather events," has passed the General Assembly.

item.title: KSP investigating after inmate walks away from Pike County Detention Center
item.description: Kentucky State Police is investigating after an inmate reportedly walked away from the Pike County Detention Center just before 6 p.m. Wednesday.

item.title: Data center opposition grows in Mercer County as residents voice concerns
item.description: More than 1,700 residents have signed a petition opposing a potential data center in Mercer County, and dozens gathered at a public meeting on Wednesday night to voice their opposition to the project.
